reflection.reasoning: 17项中有15项关系标签正确，13项达到标签与证据联合完全匹配。合同第15段要求未经书面许可不得复制，并要求在披露方请求时返还专有信息及其副本；据此，nda-17应为Contradiction、nda-20也应为Contradiction，二者证据均为[15]。此外，第8段是第12、13段例外条款的引导语，因此nda-12和nda-13虽标签正确，但完整证据应分别为[8,13]和[8,12]。其余13项预测与完整证据均正确。
reflection.error_identification: 主要有两处标签错误和两处证据遗漏：nda-17被误判为Entailment，而标准答案依据第15段的禁止复制规则判为Contradiction；nda-20被误判为NotMentioned，但第15段的返还义务排斥返还后继续保留，故应为Contradiction。nda-12和nda-13分别漏引了作为例外条款共同前提的第8段。
reflection.root_cause_analysis: 模型把“须经书面许可”推演成了积极的复制许可，从条件限制中构造了合同未明确授予的权利；同时，它将“返还后保留”理解成必须有明文许可才可判断，忽略了无保留例外的返还义务与继续占有之间的直接冲突。证据选择上只引用具体子项，未把引入并限定这些子项法律作用的总括句一并纳入。
reflection.correct_approach: 先逐项判断合同是否直接支持、直接排斥或未处理命题，不从批准机制推定积极权利。对nda-17，应依据第15段“不得复制，除非获得书面许可”的禁止性表述按基准标为Contradiction并引用[15]；对nda-20，应以返还信息及所有副本的义务标为Contradiction并引用[15]。对例外清单，应同时引用总括句和具体分项：nda-12用[8,13]，nda-13用[8,12]。其他原有判断保持不变。

reflection.reasoning: 模型在17项中有16项关系标签正确，但只有6项达到“标签+完整证据”联合精确匹配。核心标签错误是nda-16：第39—41段将返还或销毁义务触发于披露方请求，而非协议终止，因此应为NotMentioned且证据为空。其余主要问题是证据集合不完整、冗余或选错。
reflection.error_identification: nda-16被错误判为Entailment，并将第40、41段中的“应请求返还或销毁”误述为“终止时返还或销毁”。证据方面：nda-10漏26、28；nda-19漏104；nda-18漏65、68；nda-4漏31；nda-7与nda-5应为11、35而非11、24；nda-17应为29、33、44而非45；nda-13应为16、19而非16、18；nda-2和nda-3多引15；nda-8多引56。nda-11、nda-15、nda-1、nda-12、nda-20的标签与证据均正确。

reflection.correct_approach: 先逐项拆分主体、行为、对象、条件和时间触发词，再要求合同文本逐一匹配。若关键条件未被文本表达，应判NotMentioned，不能用相近义务补足。随后独立执行证据审计：仅保留直接支持关系的段落，同时补齐金标准要求的所有相关段落。按给定答案，nda-16应改为NotMentioned且spans为空；其余错误项的证据应分别校正为nda-10[24,25,26,28]、nda-2[16]、nda-19[46,104]、nda-3[16]、nda-18[58,65,68]、nda-7[11,35]、nda-17[29,33,44]、nda-8[55]、nda-13[16,19]、nda-5[11,35]、nda-4[29,30,31]。

reflection.reasoning: The prediction got 11 of 17 relation labels correct, but only five items were jointly exact in both label and evidence: nda-11, nda-15, nda-10, nda-18, and nda-5. Six labels were wrong (nda-16, nda-19, nda-20, nda-3, nda-7, nda-17), and six otherwise-correct labels used incomplete or excessive evidence (nda-2, nda-1, nda-12, nda-8, nda-13, nda-4). The contract supports only what its text expressly states; related subject matter or a plausible implication is insufficient.
reflection.error_identification: The model conflated different conditions and concepts. For nda-16, span 26 triggers return or destruction upon request, not upon termination, so the answer should be NotMentioned with no spans. For nda-19, spans 26–27 contain no survival clause, so it is NotMentioned. For nda-20, span 26 requires return or destruction of all originals, copies, reproductions, and summaries, contradicting permitted retention. For nda-3, information 'received from others' in span 8 concerns source, not verbal transmission, so verbal disclosure is NotMentioned. For nda-7, span 17 does not resolve the specific permission to disclose to consultants, agents, or advisers, so the correct relation is NotMentioned. For nda-17, employee access in span 21 does not entail permission to make copies, so it is NotMentioned. Evidence was also overselected for nda-2 (only span 8), nda-1 (only span 7), and nda-4 (only span 17), while required evidence was omitted for nda-12 (spans 10 and 14), nda-8 (10 and 15), and nda-13 (10, 13, and 31).
reflection.root_cause_analysis: The root cause was inference by thematic association rather than strict textual entailment. The model treated request-based duties as termination-based duties, remedies as surviving obligations, information source as communication medium, access as copying authority, and a general disclosure restriction as a specific answer about named third parties. It also treated evidence spans as merely illustrative instead of an exact binary set, adding contextual but unnecessary spans and omitting definition or exception-introduction spans required by the reference evidence.
reflection.correct_approach: Match every material element of each hypothesis to explicit contract language, including actor, permission or duty, object, trigger, timing, and modality. If a material element such as termination, survival, verbal conveyance, specified third-party sharing, or copying is absent, use NotMentioned rather than filling the gap by implication. Use Contradiction only when the text affirmatively conflicts with the hypothesis, as span 26 does with post-return retention. Then select the exact evidence sets: nda-11 []; nda-16 []; nda-15 [28,29]; nda-10 [18]; nda-2 [8]; nda-1 [7]; nda-19 []; nda-12 [10,14]; nda-20 [26]; nda-3 []; nda-18 []; nda-7 []; nda-17 []; nda-8 [10,15]; nda-13 [10,13,31]; nda-5 [21]; nda-4 [17].
reflection.key_insight: Entailment requires every material limitation in the hypothesis to be textually supported; similarity of topic is not enough. Distinguish triggers, timing, media, recipients, and authorized acts, and treat evidence selection as exact-set matching: include every required span and no merely related span.

reflection.reasoning: The response correctly classified 13 of 17 hypotheses, but four labels were wrong and three otherwise-correct entailments had incomplete evidence. Span 31 entails nda-16 because the disjunction “destroy or return” is satisfied by a return obligation, and contradicts nda-20 because it requires return of the furnished materials and all copies. Spans 40–41 entail nda-19 by continuing confidentiality obligations beyond termination. Span 23 supports employee disclosure (nda-5), but does not authorize making copies, so nda-17 is NotMentioned. The evidence sets for nda-15, nda-12, and nda-4 also omitted required spans 29; 16 and 20; and 33 and 43, respectively.
reflection.error_identification: The model mislabeled nda-16, nda-19, nda-20, and nda-17. It treated the absence of “destruction” as defeating nda-16 despite the hypothesis’s disjunctive “destroy or return”; overlooked the post-termination duration in spans 40–41; treated a comprehensive return requirement as mere silence about retention; and inferred permission to copy from permission to disclose to employees. It also returned incomplete binary evidence for nda-15, nda-12, and nda-4.
reflection.root_cause_analysis: The main errors were faulty logical matching and unsupported implication. The model read “or” as though both alternatives had to appear, required the word “survive” instead of recognizing an obligation that remains effective after termination, failed to use an opposing contractual duty as contradiction evidence, and conflated disclosure with reproduction. Separately, it selected one sufficient-looking passage rather than collecting the complete annotated evidence set.
reflection.correct_approach: Evaluate each hypothesis propositionally: test direct support, direct incompatibility, and genuine silence without requiring identical wording. For nda-16, recognize that mandated return in span 31 satisfies “destroy or return.” For nda-19, use spans 40–41 because confidentiality continues for a stated period after termination. For nda-20, classify the retention permission as contradicted by span 31’s return of materials and all copies. For nda-17, classify copying as NotMentioned because employee access in span 23 says nothing about creating copies. Then gather all gold-relevant spans: nda-15 [28,29,33], nda-12 [16,20,37], and nda-4 [22,33,43]. Preserve the remaining correct labels and evidence unchanged.
reflection.key_insight: Match legal hypotheses by logical force, not keyword identity: one satisfied branch proves an inclusive disjunction; an obligation extending past termination establishes survival; an exhaustive return duty can contradict retention; and permission for one act never implies permission for a distinct act. After labeling, independently verify that the cited evidence set is complete and contains no merely inferred spans.

reflection.reasoning: The prediction got 14 of 17 relation labels correct but only 8 of 17 label-and-evidence pairs exactly correct. Exact matches were nda-11, nda-15, nda-10, nda-1, nda-19, nda-18, nda-8, and nda-4. The three incorrect relations were nda-2, nda-20, and nda-17. Six additional answers had correct relations but incomplete or excessive evidence: nda-16, nda-12, nda-3, nda-7, nda-13, and nda-5.
reflection.error_identification: For nda-2, span 7 describes communication forms (oral, written, or otherwise), not technical versus non-technical subject matter, so it does not contradict the hypothesis; the correct label is NotMentioned with no evidence. For nda-20, span 20 requires documents, information, and copies to be returned or destroyed, contradicting retained possession; the model incorrectly chose NotMentioned. For nda-17, acknowledging that copies may exist and must be returned or destroyed does not authorize making copies, so the correct label is NotMentioned. Evidence was also mishandled: nda-16 required [6,9], not [9,20]; nda-12 required [14,18]; nda-3 required [6,7]; nda-7 and nda-5 each required [6,10,11,12,13]; and nda-13 required [14,17].
reflection.root_cause_analysis: The model conflated a provision's presuppositions with permissions and confused information format with information category. It also selected isolated operative phrases without preserving the introductory or linking spans needed to establish their subject, scope, and exception structure. Conversely, it added span 20 to nda-16 even though that span concerns return or destruction upon written request rather than upon termination.
reflection.correct_approach: First classify each relation using only express contractual effect: choose Entailment when the contract establishes the hypothesis, Contradiction when it establishes the incompatible rule, and NotMentioned when it neither establishes nor rejects it. Do not infer permission merely because the contract regulates an item that may exist. Then extract the complete minimal evidence chain, including lead-in spans that supply the parties, governing obligation, or exception framework. The corrected disputed outputs are nda-2: NotMentioned []; nda-20: Contradiction [20]; nda-17: NotMentioned []; nda-16: Entailment [6,9]; nda-12: Entailment [14,18]; nda-3: Entailment [6,7]; nda-7 and nda-5: Entailment [6,10,11,12,13]; and nda-13: Entailment [14,17].
reflection.key_insight: Distinguish express authorization from mere reference, and semantic subject matter from communication medium. After deciding the relation, verify evidence as an exact binary set: include every span needed to reconstruct the rule and exclude related provisions that operate under a different trigger.

reflection.reasoning: 17个关系标签全部正确；错误仅在证据跨度选择。根据合同与环境反馈，nda-16、nda-15、nda-12、nda-20、nda-8和nda-13未达到证据集合精确匹配，其余11项完全正确。
reflection.root_cause_analysis: 模型正确判断了法律关系，却把“足以解释结论的少量片段”误当成“完整且精确的二元证据集合”。它未系统纳入同一命题的条款引导句、规则句及重复适用条款，也混淆了第三方取得相似信息与口头信息属于保密信息这两个不同概念。

reflection.key_insight: 标签正确不等于联合答案正确；证据评估要求与标准集合同时满足完整性和精确性，即既不能漏掉必要跨度，也不能加入仅相关但不构成证明的跨度。

actual_teacher_value.reasoning: 现有 playbook 为空，因此反思中反复出现且可跨合同复用的原则均属于新增内容。主要失误集中在三类：把主题相关或可能成立误当作明文支持；忽略触发条件、行为类型和逻辑连接词的精确差异；以及未将证据视为完整且无冗余的精确集合。以下条目覆盖关系判定、逻辑匹配和证据审计，同时避免保存任何具体文档标识、主体、日期、跨度编号或逐案答案。

operations.content: 将假设拆成主体、规范模态、行为、对象、条件、触发事件和时间范围；所有关键要素均获文本支持才判 Entailment，文本确立不相容规则才判 Contradiction，否则判 NotMentioned。
按法律效果而非关键词同一性匹配：明确的终止后持续期限可以证明义务存续，而“返还或销毁”这类包容性析取只需文本强制其中一个分支即可满足。
合同对某事项的提及、预设或管制不等于授予该事项的权限；只有明确许可或必然授权才能支持“可以”类假设。
全面返还、销毁且不得保留副本的义务可直接反驳返还后继续持有，但明示的备份、档案或法务留存例外可支持有限保留。
不得把“应请求时”替换为“协议终止时”，也不得用主题相近但触发事件不同的条款补足缺失条件。
不得混同行为类型：获准访问或向员工披露不产生复制权，信息来自第三方不表示其以口头方式传达，补救条款也不自动证明义务存续。
“未经书面同意不得实施”首先是禁止性规则，不能仅因存在同意机制就推导合同已积极授予实施权。
先独立确定关系标签，再执行证据审计；不要让附近段落或预先选定的证据反向驱动标签。
把证据当作精确二元集合：纳入重建规则所必需的定义、引导句、 operative clause、例外或延续条款，排除仅提供背景、主题相关或适用不同触发条件的段落。
完成初选后扫描全文中的重复、并列和交叉引用条款，补齐共同支持同一命题的必要片段，同时逐条做删除测试以清除冗余证据。
例外清单通常依赖其总括引导语才能产生法律效果；引用具体分项时，应检查是否还需包含定义范围或“不适用前述义务”等共同前提。
严格区分信息的主题类别、载体形式和来源渠道：技术或非技术是内容范围，口头或书面是传递形式，第三方取得是来源，三者不可互相推断。
遇到“所有副本”“不得保留”“仅限”“除非”“在请求时”“终止后”等词语时，将其视为决定范围、排他性、例外、触发或存续的高权重限定词。

## STRATEGIES & INSIGHTS

[sai-00001] helpful=3 harmful=0 :: 将假设拆成主体、规范模态、行为、对象、条件、触发事件和时间范围；所有关键要素均获文本支持才判 Entailment，文本确立不相容规则才判 Contradiction，否则判 NotMentioned。
[sai-00002] helpful=2 harmful=1 :: 按法律效果而非关键词同一性匹配：明确的终止后持续期限可以证明义务存续，而“返还或销毁”这类包容性析取只需文本强制其中一个分支即可满足。
[sai-00003] helpful=3 harmful=0 :: 合同对某事项的提及、预设或管制不等于授予该事项的权限；只有明确许可或必然授权才能支持“可以”类假设。
[sai-00004] helpful=3 harmful=0 :: 全面返还、销毁且不得保留副本的义务可直接反驳返还后继续持有，但明示的备份、档案或法务留存例外可支持有限保留。
[sai-00016] helpful=1 harmful=0 :: 区分明示例外与同意门槛：禁止条款后的“可向需要知悉者披露”或“except”可形成附条件许可，而“未经同意不得披露”仅规定禁令及其解除条件，不能证明同意已经给予。
[sai-00018] helpful=1 harmful=0 :: 若独立开发或从无保密义务的第三方合法取得的信息被明示排除于保密信息或保密义务之外，该排除可支持相应的开发或取得自由，但必须保留“不依赖受保护信息”“来源有权披露”等限定条件。
[sai-00019] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 一般用途限制与特殊授权并存时，按适用对象和例外结构协调解释；例如对残留知识、特定副本或特定渠道的明确自由使用可在其范围内反驳“任何信息均只能用于约定目的”的全称命题。

## COMMON MISTAKES TO AVOID

[err-00005] helpful=1 harmful=1 :: 不得把“应请求时”替换为“协议终止时”，也不得用主题相近但触发事件不同的条款补足缺失条件。
[err-00006] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 不得混同行为类型：获准访问或向员工披露不产生复制权，信息来自第三方不表示其以口头方式传达，补救条款也不自动证明义务存续。
[err-00007] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: “未经书面同意不得实施”首先是禁止性规则，不能仅因存在同意机制就推导合同已积极授予实施权。
[err-00021] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 不得把针对特定名单、会议、平台或组织内部人员的披露许可泛化为向任意顾问、代理人或第三方披露；许可对象、渠道、目的和知悉必要性均须逐项匹配。
## PROBLEM-SOLVING HEURISTICS

[ph-00008] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 先独立确定关系标签，再执行证据审计；不要让附近段落或预先选定的证据反向驱动标签。
[ph-00009] helpful=2 harmful=0 :: 把证据当作精确二元集合：纳入重建规则所必需的定义、引导句、 operative clause、例外或延续条款，排除仅提供背景、主题相关或适用不同触发条件的段落。
[ph-00010] helpful=2 harmful=0 :: 完成初选后扫描全文中的重复、并列和交叉引用条款，补齐共同支持同一命题的必要片段，同时逐条做删除测试以清除冗余证据。
[ph-00014] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 先标准化量词与类属关系：“全部”规则可支持“部分”命题，“部分”只需一个明确覆盖的子类；反驳全称命题须找到明确不受该条件限制的覆盖实例，并应通过合同定义确认员工、顾问等是否属于“代表”。
[ph-00017] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 一旦关系判为 NotMentioned，输出证据集合应为空；主题相关条款只能用于内部确认关键要素缺失，不得作为中性标签的引证。
[ph-00020] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 判断协议存在、谈判事实或协议条款本身是否受保密约束时，通常需连接两层规则：先确认该事项被纳入保密信息定义，再确认保密或禁止披露的操作性条款确实适用于该定义。
## CONTEXT CLUES & INDICATORS

[ctx-00011] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: 例外清单通常依赖其总括引导语才能产生法律效果；引用具体分项时，应检查是否还需包含定义范围或“不适用前述义务”等共同前提。
[ctx-00012] helpful=3 harmful=0 :: 严格区分信息的主题类别、载体形式和来源渠道：技术或非技术是内容范围，口头或书面是传递形式，第三方取得是来源，三者不可互相推断。
[ctx-00013] helpful=3 harmful=0 :: 遇到“所有副本”“不得保留”“仅限”“除非”“在请求时”“终止后”等词语时，将其视为决定范围、排他性、例外、触发或存续的高权重限定词。
[ctx-00015] helpful=1 harmful=0 :: 若保密信息定义以“所有”“无论形式”或“包括但不限于”自动覆盖信息且不以标识为条件，可反驳“全部信息必须明示标识”的全称命题；仅仅没有写出标识要求则不足以构成矛盾。
## OTHERS

actual_teacher_value.reasoning: 现有规则已覆盖开放世界判断、主体与行为边界、许可和禁止的区分、触发条件以及证据最小完备性。仍缺少两个反复出现且可泛化的判别点：第一，限制使用或保密义务不能替代明确的“不授予权利”条款；第二，反驳“仅包含某类信息”需要文本明确纳入该类之外的信息，抽象的宽泛定义本身不足。另需补充例外条款中的谓词精度，避免把“独立知悉”等状态误读为“独立开发”等行为。

operations.content: 对“不授予任何权利或许可”类假设，须寻找明确的无许可、无权利或权利保留条款；保密义务、限定用途、专属利益或所有权表述本身不足以证明全面不授权。
反驳“保密信息仅包含某一类别”的全称命题，须有明示的类别外信息、具体类别外示例或“技术及非技术”等并列表述；“所有有商业价值的信息”等抽象宽泛定义通常不足以单独建立矛盾。
不得把例外中的状态或来源谓词改写成另一行为：独立知悉不等于独立开发，信息已为他人所知不等于接收方可从第三方取得；必须逐字核对谁实施了何种行为及其来源条件。
